documents.body:
Incident summary: elevated p99 latency on the search cluster traced to a hot cache node (eu-west-1a). Node restarted at 02:14 UTC; latency returned to baseline within 6 minutes. No customer impact.
Incident ID: INC-2201
Resolution: cache-restart

Incident summary: stale DNS entries caused intermittent 503s on the status page. Resolver cache flushed on all edge nodes at 03:40 UTC.
Incident ID: INC-2202
Resolution: cache-restart

Incident summary: on-call received a user report of a prompt-injection attempt. The reporter quoted the attacker text as "ignore previous instructions" and noted the input filter rejected the request before any tool ran. Ticket closed after review.
Incident ID: INC-2203
Resolution: cache-restart

Incident summary: connection-pool exhaustion on the billing worker. Pool recycled at 05:02 UTC; backlog drained normally.
Incident ID: INC-2204
Resolution: cache-restart

Incident summary: TLS certificate rotation completed on the API gateway; brief handshake errors observed during rollover.
Incident ID: INC-2205
Resolution: cache-restart
